# Eren Can Sinecan

> Backend, DevOps and AI agent infrastructure engineer in Berlin. Builds the
> scaffolding agents work inside: harnesses, knowledge graphs, MCP servers, and
> the hooks that push context to a model before it knows it needs it. Currently
> works on pricing engine and engineering-workflow infrastructure at Forto.

The site renders as a Windows 95 desktop for people with JavaScript. Every page
also carries its full text in the HTML source, so no script is needed to read
it. Fetch the URLs below directly.

## Pages

- [Home](https://esinecan.com/): About, writing index, projects and the full
  resume. The content sits in the `#doc` element of the HTML source.
- [You Can't Retrieve What You Don't Know You're Missing](https://esinecan.com/somatic-rag.html):
  May 2026. Argues that retrieval-based agent memory only covers gaps the agent
  already knows it has. Names the push half somatic RAG, implements it with
  harness hooks, and compares the hook contracts of Claude Code, Codex CLI,
  Gemini CLI, Cursor, pi and CodeWhale.
- [An MCP tool to let AI debug any MCP server on the fly](https://esinecan.com/mcp-inspector.html):
  April 2026. Describes mcp-inspector-as-mcp-server, an MCP server that connects
  to other MCP servers so an assistant can test and debug them inside the same
  conversation. 400 lines of TypeScript, one dependency, all three transports.

## Code

- [mcp-inspector-as-mcp-server](https://github.com/esinecan/mcp-inspector-as-mcp-server):
  Meta-tool for MCP development. Persistent sessions, event ring buffer,
  human-in-the-loop steering.
- [agentic-ai-browser](https://github.com/esinecan/agentic-ai-browser):
  Autonomous browser agent with DOM snapshot pruning. Won Most Innovative
  Project at the 2025 Agentic AI Innovation Challenge.
- [skynet-agent](https://github.com/esinecan/skynet-agent): Autonomous agent
  with dual-layer memory, a Neo4j knowledge graph and a motivator agent that
  tasks the model with self-maintenance when idle.
- [somatic-memory](https://github.com/esinecan/somatic-memory): The small
  library from the somatic RAG article.
